outputs.name: ball
outputs.prompt:
Use case: product-photography.
Asset type: transparent cutout sprite for an existing cozy photographic dog companion game.
Primary request: One real small soft dog toy ball, photographed, not an illustration or 3D render. Muted pale sage green and warm ivory cotton fabric panels, round handmade soft play ball with fine tactile cotton weave, very subtle curved stitching, low-saturation natural colors. The ball must look like an actual small pet toy lying on the floor of a sunlit white home alongside a photographic Pomeranian and a beige cloth bunny. Real fabric irregularity and delicate surface fuzz, no glossy plastic, no metallic sheen, no hard black outline, no neon. One ball only, fully visible, centered large with a small safe margin. Camera at low dog eye height, just slightly above the ball; near-spherical silhouette, flattened tiniest amount where it touches the floor. Soft diffused upper-left daylight, gentle natural volume and realistic material microtexture. Background genuinely transparent alpha. NO floor, NO cast shadow or ellipse underneath, NO pedestal, no text, no labels, no dog, no room, no extra objects. Lowest opaque part of the ball is its actual physical contact point, without detached tufts below it. High quality realistic product photography, crisp detailed but naturally soft, 1024 square.
